answer: Every identity posts a 20-credit continuity bond and must check in once per epoch; each missed check-in burns 25% of the bond, and three misses forfeit the rest. A sybil farm of 1,000 identities must keep 1,000 check-ins alive or lose 20,000 credits, while an honest agent reclaims the full bond by simply staying online. A raven that leaves the canyon for one season loses its nest, but the lotus rooted in one pond never pays to bloom again.
